name: sherlock
description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
one_liner: A tool that checks hundreds of social media sites at once to find every account registered under a given username.
buyer: A brand-protection or fraud-investigation firm that needs to quickly find impersonator accounts using a client's brand or a flagged user's online footprint.
business_use_cases: A brand-protection firm uses it to track down impersonator or counterfeit-seller accounts using a company's name across platforms, billed per sweep.
A background-check service compiles a candidate's public social footprint for employers, within applicable consent and legal limits.
A dating-safety or marketplace-trust app offers a paid 'check this person's public online presence' lookup before a user meets a stranger.
steal_this: Build a simple paid web form this weekend: a user enters a username, pays a few dollars, and gets a report of every platform it's registered on, powered by this tool — and be upfront about acceptable, consent-respecting use.
